answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the quartz of free entry disappears, the walnut of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the ferrous case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
